title: Manufacturing, storing, selling, distributing or importing spurious goods causing injury not amounting to grievous hurt
description: Manufacturing, storing, selling, distributing or importing spurious goods causing injury not amounting to grievous hurt to the consumer

content.offence: Manufactures for sale or stores or sells or distributes or imports any spurious goods causing injury not amounting to grievous hurt to the consumer
content.punishment: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year and with fine which may extend to three lakh rupees
